title: Implement Crawlee CheerioCrawler service
description: Implement the core Crawlee CheerioCrawler service in src/scraper/crawlee-service.ts. This service crawls a given URL, follows internal links up to maxPages, and collects raw page data for extraction. Runs locally for free — no external API costs.
acceptanceCriteria: `crawlSite(url, maxPages)` function crawls the given URL and follows internal links
Only same-domain links are followed (no crawling off to Facebook, Google, etc.)
Has a 30-second overall timeout — returns whatever pages collected so far
Returns an array of raw page objects with URL and raw HTML
Sets a realistic browser User-Agent string
Concurrency is limited to 3 concurrent requests

steps.details:
Import `CheerioCrawler` from `crawlee`. Create async function `crawlSite(url: string, maxPages = 10)`. Initialize CheerioCrawler with:
- `maxRequestsPerCrawl: maxPages`
- `maxConcurrency: 3`
- `requestHandlerTimeoutSecs: 30`
- `navigationTimeoutSecs: 30`
- `additionalMimeTypes: ['text/html']`

In the requestHandler, parse the input URL to get the base domain (using `new URL(url).hostname`). In `enqueueLinks`, use a `transformRequestFunction` or `urlPatternMatcher` that only allows links where `new URL(link).hostname === baseDomain`. This prevents crawling off-site.

steps.description: Implement page data collection in requestHandler
steps.details: In the requestHandler, collect: `request.url`, `$.html()` (full raw HTML), `$('title').text()` for title. Push each result to a `pages` array using a closure. After crawler finishes, return the pages array.

Configure the crawler with a realistic browser User-Agent via `useSessionPool: true` or the `headers` option: `'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'`
Wrap the `crawler.run([url])` call in a `Promise.race` with a 30-second timeout. If the timeout fires, call `crawler.teardown()` and return whatever pages have been collected so far.
Create a quick test script (or use tsx directly) to call `crawlSite('https://example.com', 3)` and log the number of pages returned. Verify it returns at least 1 page with raw HTML.

technicalNotes: Crawlee writes temporary files to ./storage/ during crawls. Add ./storage/ to .gitignore.

CheerioCrawler is the lightweight option (no headless browser). It handles all static HTML sites perfectly. Target market uses WordPress/Wix/Squarespace/hand-coded HTML — all CheerioCrawler compatible.
If a prospect has a JS SPA (React, Vue), CheerioCrawler will get the empty shell. This is acceptable — they likely don't need our services anyway.
Crawlee may log verbose output — consider setting `Configuration.getGlobalConfig().set('logLevel', LogLevel.WARNING')`
